title: Business Development Associate
description:
**Role Overview** 




 This is a sales\-focused role with a clear path to closing deals, not just lead generation. You’ll be trained to handle real business conversations, understand buyer intent, and gradually move prospects toward decisions.
 



 The role combines smart outreach, demand generation, and conversation intelligence—with the end goal of conversion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Initiate and manage conversations across LinkedIn, Telegram, email, and online platforms
 



 • Understand prospect requirements and identify decision signals
 



 • Support in moving conversations from interest → intent → closure
 



 • Learn objection handling and negotiation fundamentals
 



 • Maintain structured follow\-ups and deal tracking
 



 • Assist in onboarding and closing coordination
 



 • Continuously refine messaging based on response patterns
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • Strong communication (written \+ verbal)
 



 • Hunger to move beyond “just leads” and learn closing skills
 



 • Ability to think, adapt, and respond—not rely on scripts
 



 • Active on digital platforms and comfortable initiating conversations
 



 • Basic familiarity with AI tools for smarter outreach
 



 • Highly self\-driven and consistent
 



  





**Mindset Fit** 




 • You’re not satisfied with replies—you want outcomes
 



 • You’re curious about why people buy
 



 • You can handle rejection and still stay consistent

description:
**Industry \& Sector:** 
 Real Estate — Residential and Commercial property sales and brokerage with field\-driven client acquisition and on\-site closings.
   

  

**Standardized Title:** 
 Real Estate Sales Executive
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 We are hiring an on\-site sales professional for a fast\-paced real estate brokerage/proptech\-enabled sales operation across India. This role focuses on converting leads into property sales, managing end\-to\-end client engagement, and delivering measurable revenue growth in assigned territories.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Drive property sales by prospecting, qualifying, and converting inbound leads, walk\-ins, and cold outreach to signed agreements.
* Manage a sales pipeline in CRM—track leads, schedule site visits, prepare proposals, negotiate terms, and close deals to meet monthly KPIs.
* Conduct regular on\-site property tours, client consultations, and local market demos to showcase inventory and value propositions.
* Maintain and update property listings, documentation, and pricing; coordinate with operations, legal, and finance teams to ensure smooth handovers.
* Upsell and cross\-sell relevant inventory, drive repeat business and referrals by delivering exceptional post\-sale service.
* Report sales metrics, forecast monthly revenue, and participate in local marketing or community events to boost brand visibility.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* 2\+ years proven field sales experience in residential/commercial real estate or property brokerage with consistent target achievement.
* Strong negotiation and closing skills; comfortable handling pricing discussions, offers, and contracts.
* Proficiency with CRM tools (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or equivalent) and basic MS Office for proposals and reporting.


**Preferred**
* Existing local market network, property owner/developer relationships, or a book of leads in the assigned city/region.
* Experience with on\-site customer engagement, property valuations, and end\-to\-end transaction coordination.
* Familiarity with compliance/documentation for property sales and basic legal processes for closures.


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* On\-site, field\-first role with uncapped commissions and performance incentives tied to monthly/quarterly targets.
* Rapid career progression for top performers into senior sales or regional leadership roles.
* Collaborative, KPI\-driven culture with training on sales best practices, CRM workflows, and local market strategies.


**Location:** 
 On\-site (India). Candidates must be comfortable with local travel and frequent site visits.
   

  

 If you are a target\-oriented real estate sales professional with strong negotiation skills and a proven closing record, apply to join a fast\-moving team that rewards performance and hustle.
   

  

 Skills: client relationship management,sales,crm,sales \& marketing,skills,communication,real estate,estate sales

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
We are seeking a dynamic Sales Engineer/Manager with 3\-8 years of experience in electrical engineering to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background with expertise in
 **Emergency Water Systems (EWS), Industrial Process Automation and Software Solutions around Multi Assets Integration over Wired/ Wireless Media.** 
 The role primarily involves liaising with clients, understanding their requirements, and preparing compelling proposals to meet their needs.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities:***




 1\. Identify and develop new business opportunities in EWS, Industrial Automation and Software Solutions.
 



 2\. Engage with potential clients to understand their technical requirements and business objectives.
 



 3\. Collaborate with internal technical teams to develop customized solutions that meet client specifications.
 



 4\. To create vendor databases for relevant items.
 



 5\. Prepare and deliver technical proposals, including scope of work, cost estimates, and timelines.
 



 6\. Present proposals to clients and address any technical queries or concerns they may have.
 



 7\. Stay abreast of industry trends, technologies, and competitors' offerings to effectively position our solutions in the market.
 



 8\. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external clients, providing ongoing support.
 



 9\. Work closely with project managers and engineers to ensure seamless execution of projects from proposal acceptance to project completion.
 



***Qualifications:***




 1\. Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Instrumentation, or related field)
 



 2\. Minimum 3 years of experience in industrial automation, software solution sales.
 



 3\. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
 



 4\. Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
 



 5\. Self\-motivated, result\-oriented, and capable of working independently.

description:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗔𝗟 𝗕𝗜𝗢𝗠𝗔𝗦𝗦 𝗣𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗘𝗧 𝗦𝗔𝗟𝗘𝗦 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗚𝗘𝗥 – 𝗕𝟮𝗕
 



 Company: Rohit Exergy India Private Limited
 



 Location: Delhi NCR
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Industry: Biomass Energy \| Renewable Energy \| Industrial Fuel
 



 Function: Sales \& Business Development
 



  





 𝗔𝗕𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘
 



 Rohit Exergy India Private Limited is looking for an experienced Industrial Biomass Pellet Sales Manager to take ownership of B2B sales and business development for our premium\-quality wood pellets used in industrial heating applications.
 



 This is a hands\-on sales role for a professional who understands the industrial biomass pellet market, has existing customer relationships, and can independently generate, develop and close business.
 



 𝗜𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧: Prior experience in selling wood pellets to industrial customers is mandatory.
 



  





 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗥𝗘𝗦𝗣𝗢𝗡𝗦𝗜𝗕𝗜𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗘𝗦
 



 • Take complete ownership of industrial biomass pellet sales and business development.
 



 • Generate new leads independently and develop recurring industrial customers.
 



 • Utilize existing customer networks and relationships to generate business.
 



 • Identify industries currently using coal, LPG, diesel, furnace oil, biomass or competing wood pellets.
 



 • Identify and develop opportunities for premium\-quality wood pellets.
 



 • Conduct customer meetings, plant visits and fuel assessments.
 



 • Coordinate pellet trials and support conversion from existing fuels or pellet suppliers.
 



 • Present the technical and commercial benefits of premium\-quality pellets.
 



 • Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, techno\-commercial offers and customer documentation.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and close orders.
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams regarding product specifications, pricing, delivery schedules and payment terms.
 



 • Track orders, deliveries, collections and repeat business.
 



 • Build long\-term customer relationships and increase monthly sales tonnage.
 



 • Identify opportunities for pellet burners and industrial heating solutions.
 



  





 𝗪𝗘 𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗙𝗢𝗥
 



 • Direct wood pellet sales experience — mandatory.
 



 • Existing network of industrial customers purchasing biomass/wood pellets.
 



 • Proven personal pellet sales performance in MT/month.
 



 • Experience selling premium or consistent\-quality pellets.
 



 • Strong independent lead\-generation capability.
 



 • Strong negotiation, closing and relationship\-management skills.
 



 • Understanding of industrial fuel applications and customer economics.
 



 • Understanding of GCV, moisture, ash, combustion performance, fuel consumption and thermal efficiency.
 



 • Experience with boilers, dryers, furnaces, thermic fluid heaters, hot air generators or other industrial heating systems will be highly valuable.
 



 • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, plant visits and trials.
 



  





 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗜𝗚𝗛𝗧 𝗖𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗘
 



 We are looking for someone who can build business, not just handle leads.
 



 The ideal candidate should be commercially driven, technically comfortable discussing industrial fuel performance, capable of generating business independently and confident in negotiating and closing B2B industrial sales.
 



  





 Candidates with only generic B2B sales, commodity trading without direct pellet sales, briquette\-only sales or unrelated industrial sales experience will not be preferred.
 



  





 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘 𝗗𝗘𝗧𝗔𝗜𝗟𝗦
 



 Position: Industrial Biomass Pellet Sales Manager – B2B
 



 Location: Delhi NCR
 



 Experience: Relevant wood pellet sales experience mandatory
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Travel: Regular industrial customer visits required
 



 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡
 



 Competitive fixed salary \+ performance incentives.
 



  





 𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗧𝗢 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬
 



 Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn with their updated CV.
 



***Candidates may also email their CV to:***
 info.rohitexergy@gmail.com
 



***Or WhatsApp their CV at:***

 \+91 8279209794
 



 Please mention “Industrial Biomass Pellet Sales Manager” while applying.
 



  





 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗥𝗼𝗵𝗶𝘁 𝗘𝘅𝗲𝗿𝗴𝘆
